title: Using Transformers to Generate 3-Manifold Triangulations
abstract: arXiv:2611.07514v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Using dehydration signatures as an encoding, we train GPT-2-style transformers to generate triangulations of 3-dimensional manifolds. Our main runs each use approximately 3 exaFLOPs, spanning a 200 million parameter model trained on 60 million sphere triangulations to an 11 million parameter model trained on 1.1 billion sphere triangulations. The optimal model has 10 blocks, width 640 and generates dehydration signatures of closed manifolds of various topological types at a rate of 6.9%, 82% of which are spheres. To investigate how our method scales, we use the technique of IsoFLOP curves on 15-tetrahedron triangulations of the 3-sphere, over a compute range of 6 to 3000 petaFLOPs, and observe neural scaling behaviour. We extract a parameter scaling exponent of $\alpha = 0.49$ ($[0.48, 0.50]$ stat, $\pm 0.02$ syst), and an optimal ratio of 234 tokens per parameter for training. translated_title: 使用Transformer生成三维流形三角剖分
translated_abstract: 使用脱水签名作为编码，我们训练GPT-2风格的Transformer来生成三维流形的三角剖分。我们的主要实验每次运行约使用3 exaFLOP的计算量，涵盖了从在6000万个球面三角剖分上训练的2亿参数模型，到在11亿个球面三角剖分上训练的1100万参数模型。最优模型包含10个块、宽度为640，能以6.9%的比率生成具有各种拓扑类型的闭流形的脱水签名，其中82%为球面。为了研究我们的方法如何随规模扩展，我们在三维球面的15个四面体三角剖分上采用IsoFLOP曲线技术，计算量范围从6到3000 petaFLOP，并观察到了神经缩放行为。我们提取出参数缩放指数 $\alpha = 0.49$（[0.48, 0.50]为统计误差，±0.02为系统误差），以及训练中每个参数对应234个token的最优比例。此外，我们还展示了若干较小的实验……
tldr: 该论文首次将GPT-2风格的Transformer应用于生成三维流形的三角剖分，并通过IsoFLOP曲线分析揭示了神经缩放规律（参数缩放指数α=0.49，每个参数234个token的最优训练比例）。
en_tdlr: This paper trains GPT-2-style transformers to generate triangulations of 3-dimensional manifolds using dehydration signatures as encoding, and reveals neural scaling behavior through IsoFLOP curves with a parameter scaling exponent of α=0.49 and an optimal training ratio of 234 tokens per parameter.
